title: chezmoi dashboard data
description: Shape of .chezmoidata/dashboard.yaml -- presentation, logins and buttons for OliveTin. Structure only: tools/check-consistency is what cross-references tile keys against endpoints.

tiles.description: Service tiles, keyed by fieldset then by endpoint name. The group is the key, so it cannot name a section that does not exist; the endpoint name is the inner key, so the URL comes from hosts.yaml. Fieldsets render in sorted key order.

label.description: Display name. Defaults to the endpoint name.

icon.description: Iconify name, `prefix:name`, from https://icon-sets.iconify.design -- `selfhst:` covers most self-hosted apps. The template wraps it in <iconify-icon>. A name that does not exist renders blank, so check it before adding.

container.description: podman container name, which homepage reads state and CPU/memory from. A coordinate, not derivable: the endpoint name differs from the quadlet stem (`books` is `systemd-calibre-web-automated`), and podman prefixes `systemd-` only where the quadlet sets no ContainerName. Omit for anything that is not a container.

widget.description: A homepage widget on this tile. A tile with one renders even if its endpoint has no port -- `minecraft` has nothing to link to but a status worth showing. OliveTin ignores widgets; its tile is only a link.

type.description: Homepage widget name, e.g. slskd, minecraft, calibreweb. An unknown name renders an error card.

scheme.description: Scheme of the widget's url. The url itself is built as <scheme>://<name>.<domain>[:<port>], so the domain is never written here.

port.description: Appended to the widget url. For a service the widget reaches on its own port rather than through Caddy.

item.description: Key in secrets.items holding this widget's credentials. Required if `fields` is set.

fields.description: Maps a homepage widget field to the 1Password field on `item` holding it. Rendered into homepage.env and referenced from services.yaml as {{HOMEPAGE_VAR_<TILE>_<FIELD>}}, so no secret lands in a config file.

users.description: OliveTin local logins. The password hash itself lives in 1Password, never here.

group.description: Which ACL applies. Both names are hard-coded in config.yaml.tmpl.

oneOf.description: Every action, including ones added later.

secret.description: Field name in the `olivetin` 1Password item holding the argon2id hash. Must be inside a section.

actions.description: Buttons, keyed by the Controls fieldset they sit in. The group is the key, so it cannot name a section that does not exist; fieldsets render in sorted key order.

title.description: OliveTin's identity for the action -- must be unique.

icon.description: Iconify name, `prefix:name`. The template wraps it in <iconify-icon>.

timeout.description: Seconds. OliveTin kills the command past this.

confirm.description: Adds a confirmation argument before it runs.

family.description: true also grants the `family` ACL. admins always have it.

popup.description: true shows the command's stdout in a modal as it runs, instead of leaving it behind a click through to the logs. For informational buttons.

role.description: Only render this action on a host with this role. Omit for actions that work anywhere.

on.description: Run this action over ssh on the named host instead of locally. The host must be a key in hosts.yaml.

argument.description: An input for the action. Either `choices_from` (a dropdown) or `type` (free text OliveTin validates before it runs). Reference the value from `shell` as OliveTin's own {{ name }} placeholder.

choices_from.description: Where the choices come from -- a named source, never a literal list, so the values cannot drift from the data that defines them.

type.description: An OliveTin argument type. Only types documented as shell-safe are allowed: OliveTin interpolates the value into the command without escaping, and refuses to run when it fails the type's pattern.

oneOf.description: Letters, digits, hyphen, dot, underscore. Right for a hostname.
RFC 1123 hostname. Stricter than ascii_identifier; rejects underscores.

status.description: Status fields shown beside the buttons that change them. Keyed by the same group names as `actions`.

field.description: Field emitted by dashboard-status. Its colour comes from <field>_color.
